metadata.question: Does the built-up area east of the Nile River in Cairo increase from July 1984 to September 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Landsat surface reflectance collections (1984→LC4/5; 2019→LC8). Focus on Cairo east-Nile bounds (built-up cover extractable from single SWIR1/RED/NIR bands). 2. Masking: Simple cloud & shadow via QA_PIXEL bit-mask, then build a binary built-up index (NDBI, or SWIR1>RED). Threshold ≈0 to get built-up pixels. 3. Logic: Sum built-up pixels for 1984-07 & 2019-09 inside fixed ROI; compare counts. If either sum is 0 (no valid pixels) → C2; if any calculation gives None/NaN → C3; if 2019 built-up pixels > 1984 → A, else B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon( [[[31.3, 30.05], [31.3, 30.12], [31.5, 30.12], [31.5, 30.05]]]) # East-Nile Cairo def build_col(y, m, sensor): # helper q = (ee.ImageCollection(sensor) .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(f'{y}-{m:02d}-01', f'{y}-{m:02d}-28') .map(lambda img: (img.select(['SR_B1','SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','QA_PIXEL']) .updateMask(img.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(0b1110).eq(0))))) # cloud/shadow return q.median().clip(roi) img84 = build_col(1984, 7, 'LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') img19 = build_col(2019, 9, 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') b84 = img84.select('SR_B5').subtract(img84.select('SR_B3')).gt(0) # NDBI>0 → built-up b19 = img19.select('SR_B6').subtract(img19.select('SR_B4')).gt(0) # LC8 bands shifted def built_count(img): return img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).values().get(0) c84 = built_count(b84).getInfo() c19 = built_count(b19).getInfo() print(f'1984 built-up pixels: {int(c84 if c84 else 0)}') print(f'2019 built-up pixels: {int(c19 if c19 else 0)}') if c84 is None or c19 is None or None in [c84, c19]: print('C3') elif c84 + c19 == 0: print('C2') else: print('A' if c19 > c84 else 'B') ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
        [[[31.3, 30.05], [31.3, 30.12], [31.5, 30.12], [31.5, 30.05]]])  # East-Nile Cairo

def build_col(y, m, sensor):  # helper
    q = (ee.ImageCollection(sensor)
           .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(f'{y}-{m:02d}-01', f'{y}-{m:02d}-28')
           .map(lambda img: (img.select(['SR_B1','SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','QA_PIXEL'])
                               .updateMask(img.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(0b1110).eq(0)))))  # cloud/shadow
    return q.median().clip(roi)

img84 = build_col(1984, 7, 'LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2')
img19 = build_col(2019, 9, 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')

b84 = img84.select('SR_B5').subtract(img84.select('SR_B3')).gt(0)  # NDBI>0 → built-up
b19 = img19.select('SR_B6').subtract(img19.select('SR_B4')).gt(0)  # LC8 bands shifted

def built_count(img):
    return img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).values().get(0)

c84 = built_count(b84).getInfo()
c19 = built_count(b19).getInfo()

print(f'1984 built-up pixels: {int(c84 if c84 else 0)}')
print(f'2019 built-up pixels: {int(c19 if c19 else 0)}')

if c84 is None or c19 is None or None in [c84, c19]:
    print('<answer>C3</answer>')
elif c84 + c19 == 0:
    print('<answer>C2</answer>')
else:
    print('<answer>A</answer>' if c19 > c84 else '<answer>B</answer>')
